title: 内地市场深且活：不预测方向，年内涨22%，量化如何持续捕捉离散度？
speaker: Kate Zhang

segments.en: We are doing actually pretty good this year, the year-to-date is around 22%.
segments.zh: 我们今年表现相当不错，年初至今大约22%。

segments.en: Because I think China market is enormous and also deep and liquid.
segments.zh: 因为我认为内地市场庞大、深厚且流动性充足。

segments.en: So the difference is creates dispersion and dispersion for our like quantum investors creates opportunities of alpha.
segments.zh: 所以差异创造了离散度，而离散度对我们这样的量化投资者来说创造了超额收益机会。

segments.en: You guys are up, how much this year? 22%.
So what about market neutral strategy? Market neutral strategy. Why market neutral?
segments.zh: 那市场中性策略呢？市场中性策略。为什么选择市场中性？

segments.en: I see China is a very good market for alpha and the market neutral is to hedge most of the direction of the market.
segments.zh: 我认为内地市场是获取超额收益的好市场，而市场中性是为了对冲大部分市场方向。

segments.en: So we don't need to predict the direction.
segments.zh: 所以我们不需要预测方向。

segments.en: We just have a steady dispersion.
segments.zh: 我们只需要稳定的离散度。
